observations_after_inspection: Foreground (bottom of the image): a beach of small rounded pebbles (shingle).
Left, middle distance: a steep outcrop of jointed, layered rock (a low cliff), with fallen blocks at its foot.
Right and middle distance: calm sea, with a detached rock just offshore; the horizon lies behind.
independent_solution: rock outcrop / low cliff on the left (1)
sea on the right with a detached rock offshore (1)
